props.text: Tovu v1 is open-source and self-hosted.

props.title: A CMS you actually own.
props.subtitle: Tovu runs on your machine — your content, your themes, your data. No lock-in, no per-seat pricing, no black boxes. Just a fast content platform you can read, edit, and extend.

props.title: Three ideas hold the whole thing up.

items.title: Design is data
items.body: A theme is a folder of tokens, templates, and CSS — no code. Safe to install from anyone, easy to edit, and an AI can restyle it for you.

items.title: Behavior is opt-in
items.body: Plugins add capabilities — new fields, typed hooks, components — behind explicit permissions. Themes arrange them; plugins power them.

items.title: Every change is tracked
items.body: Edits flow through one audited gateway with change-sets and one-click revert, so an assistant can safely drive the whole admin.

props.title: Themes are data, not code.
props.lead: The page you're reading is a theme. Nothing here is compiled — it's JSON templates, design tokens, and a stylesheet the server renders.
body: Because a theme is just data, it's safe to install from anyone and simple to change. Swap the palette in tokens.json, rearrange sections in the template, or hand it to an AI: “make it dark and move the intro up.”
Interactivity comes from a small set of building blocks. The nav, hero, feature grid, and footer on this page are all reusable components a theme references by name.
bullets: No executable code ships inside a theme
Full control of layout, type, and color
Editable by hand or by an AI, under change-sets

props.title: Plugins add power, safely.
props.lead: When a theme needs something new — a word counter, an SEO panel, a custom block — a plugin provides it.
body: Plugins declare exactly what they touch: content fields, a handful of typed hooks, and admin surfaces. Nothing gets a private back door. A plugin can extend a post with its own data, but it never runs raw migrations against your database.
The split stays simple: plugins are capabilities (code you trust), themes are arrangement (data anyone can edit).
bullets: Extends content without owning your schema

props.title: Runs on SQLite. Ready for more.
props.lead: Today Tovu stores everything in a single SQLite file you can copy, back up, or inspect. It's the whole database — no server to run. When you want more, you can point Tovu at another database like Postgres or Supabase later, without rewriting your site.
body: The data layer sits behind ports, so the storage engine is a swap, not a rewrite. When you outgrow a file, moving to Postgres is a configuration change — your content, themes, and plugins don't notice.
Your site lives in one folder: the database, your uploads, your themes, and your plugins. Move it, version it, or hand it to someone else.
bullets: Postgres- or Supabase-ready behind the same interface
Your whole site is a folder you own

props.title: Make it yours.
props.subtitle: Switch themes from the admin, drop a new theme folder into your site, or just start writing. This whole page is a starting point you can rewrite.

props.blurb: A content platform you actually own — your content, your themes, your data, on your machine.
